retained_failed_attempts.observation: Creating an inactive template left its generated variant default_code unset on the observed Odoo 20 target. This differs from archived reverse-relation omission by search_read.
retained_failed_attempts.resolution: The common explicit product/status staging was qualified on both majors without changing source bytes or final business answers. Earlier target and private evidence are retained.

retained_failed_attempts.observation: The initial Recipe review helper treated a normal nonblocking deferred-field advisory as an error.
retained_failed_attempts.resolution: The helper now preserves advisories, acknowledges only current warnings and rejects errors. Focused review checks and final controlled/live Recipe cases passed.

retained_failed_attempts.observation: A live Odoo 20 Recipe stopped before the South status write during native company-access metadata capture. The original subprocess return code and stderr were not retained by the adapter.
retained_failed_attempts.follow_up: The same read-only generated probe later returned code zero and empty stderr with healthy PostgreSQL. A fresh sequential Recipe case subsequently completed all seven stages. The failed target is retained.
